notes.title: WEEK LONG DEAL! Save - 35% with update: Teleportation locomotion!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33430879/e19f0c2127136f99a5dfc7405ac19a7a3d9c5c03.gif[/img]
Good news is here:
Our first sale on STEAM is live. Save 35% this week on PROZE: Enlightenment and Original Soundtrack.

The better news is here as well:
Teleportation locomotion added to PROZE.

Now PROZE features 3 movement options.
1.Free locomotion (adjustable)
2.Point & Teleport Locomotion
3.3DRudder (foot controller)

We hope that you will be pleased to progress through PROZE 
as it best fits your level of comfort.

Other improvements and fixes:
- Locomotion: improved snap turn and smooth rotations
- 3D models improvements
- Game maps improvements.
- GameDesign improvements
- Animation and game optimization
- Menu: added button to reset the view
- VIVE: hands rotation adjustment
- VIVE: fist hands fixed re-grabbing items
- VIVE: brightness fix

Hope you enjoy PROZE: Enlightenment.  Don't forget to share your experience.
Many thanks.
SignSine team.

notes.title: The fourth patch here!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33430879/464ca6b3a1984fc97ad555c25ca581ea08dbb073.jpg[/img]
Hi folks! 
We’d like to say thanks to those who continue to support PROZE: Enlightenment and give us feedback since the release.

We’ve just rolled out a new patch that includes some new features and bug fixes. 
Please find the full changelog below.

[h1]Features [/h1]
-[b]3D Rudder locomotion support [/b]
Winner of 4 CES “Innovation Awards” foot controller
Move through PROZE: Enlightenment with your feet.
Check out the info on the controller here: 
https://www.3drudder.com/

-[b]Depth of field[/b]
When you put an object in front of your face, the background becomes cinematically blurry.
Now you can turn on/off this feature in the menu.


 [h1]Improovements [/h1]
- Reactor level: coolant puzzle improvements
- Reactor level: energy enemies gameplay improvements
- Darkness level: gameplay improvements
- Eased reaching cables in the snowy bunker
- General game puzzles improvements
- Reactor level lights improvements
- start button localization
- textures improvements
- 3D models optimization

[h1]Bug fixes [/h1]
No bugs detected since the last patch, enjoy and stay tuned for the upcoming announcements. 

Let us know what you think!

Best regards! SignSine team.

notes.title: Patch Three is live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We’re dedicated to polish everything in PROZE: Enlightenment. This week’s update comes with a lot of improvements in almost every part of the game. Hope you’ll enjoy it and don’t forget to share your thoughts!

Here’s what’s new:

- Narrator voiceover - now performed by Stephane Cornicard.
- Improved Dmitry voiceover
- Minor audio enhancements
- Fixed inventory items bugs
- Fixed item highlights
- Fixed objects sticking to hands
- Added more hints
- Lightning improvements
- Performance optimization
- Fixed multiple colliders
- Lowered difficulty level in the last puzzle
- New menu option 'Show game tips’
- Improved shadows in the Cave
- Fixed multiple gameplay issues
- Items now become invisible while in the menu
- Improved 3D models
- Improved NPC animation
- Save progress icon

Hope you’ll enjoy it and don’t forget to share your thoughts!

notes.title: Patch Two is live!
notes.content:
Thanks to all our wonderful fans for the feedback since launch.
We are constantly collecting all your reports and recommendations
Tonight we uploaded the new patch with following improvements:

-Menu settings added:
	-Restart game
	-Exit game
	-Audio volume
	-Graphics
		Overall quality
		Anti-Aliasing
		Effects Quality
		Textures Quality
		Shadows Quality
-Performance optimization
-The reactor cooling system launch now runs smoothly (for sure)	
-Fixed backpack crush bug occurring in certain cases 
-Audio enhancements
-Female NPC animation fixed
-Dmitry's idle animations fixed 
-Phone grabbing fixed
-Added hints after completing the 2nd logic board
-Added hint for using Resonance
-Fixed achievements with progress
-Computer text aligning in German fixed
-Colliders added
-Various bugfixes


Please let us know in the forum or discord if you find any issues during your journey.
Many Thanks!
SignSine Team.
